name: health-analyzer
description: Apple Health analyzer PWA — root scripts for smoke & E2E

scripts.test:fhir: node scripts/fhir-structure-check.mjs && node scripts/fhir-exchange-check.mjs && node scripts/fhir-hl7-validator.mjs
scripts.test:fhir:ci: node scripts/fhir-structure-check.mjs && node scripts/fhir-exchange-check.mjs && FHIR_HL7_REQUIRED=1 node scripts/fhir-hl7-validator.mjs && FHIR_HL7_REQUIRED=1 node scripts/fhir-hl7-validator.mjs --from-export
scripts.test:all: npm run test:lib && npm run build:lib && npm run smoke && npm run test:fhir && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:release: npm run test:lib && npm run build:lib && npm run smoke && npm run test:fhir:ci && npm run test:e2e
